claims.quote: Our rock-solid support to Ukraine is vital for keeping us safe here in the UK
claims.statement: UK support to Ukraine is vital for keeping the UK safe.

claims.quote: we are with you for as long as it takes
claims.statement: The UK is with Ukraine for as long as it takes.

claims.quote: Russia’s aggression cannot be allowed to succeed on our continent.

claims.quote: our commitment to the Ukrainian people is unshakeable
claims.statement: The UK's commitment to the Ukrainian people is unshakeable.

claims.quote: to curtail the war chest funding Putin so desperately wants

claims.statement: British Lightweight Multirole Missiles have proven extremely effective against jet-powered drones.

facts.quote: President Zelenskyy will arrive in the UK this morning
facts.statement: Volodymyr Zelenskyy is due to arrive in the UK on the morning of the publication date.

facts.statement: Andy Burnham is hosting Volodymyr Zelenskyy at Downing Street on the publication date.

facts.statement: The UK is standing by plans to fully implement a maritime services ban on Russian LNG exports.

facts.statement: The UK has committed £1.6 billion to deliver more than 5000 LMMs to Ukraine over four years.

facts.statement: The Foreign Secretary urged partners at the Warsaw Security Forum to follow the UK's lead on the Russian LNG ban.

facts.quote: As Russia continues its bombardment of Ukraine’s capital Kyiv and energy infrastructure
facts.statement: Russia is continuing to bombard Ukraine's capital Kyiv and its energy infrastructure.
